summary: "Speechless" is a ballad by Michael Jackson included on his tenth studio album, "Invincible" (2001). It was released only as a promotional single in South Korea. Jackson reportedly wrote the song after a water balloon fight with children in Germany. The production involved several musicians, and Andraé Crouch with his gospel choir provided backing vocals.
one_line: Michael Jackson's ballad "Speechless" from his 2001 album Invincible, released only as a promotional single in South Korea.
